programs.title: Asian Times
programs.desc: Julian Hanton visits Asia.It checks what changes are taking place on the continent, where economic recovery goes hand in hand with population growth.The leader begins his journey in Hong Kong, where he inadvertently agrees to take a punch from Bruce Lee.This experience will be remembered for a long time.In Thailand, he makes friends with investigative journalists, becomes a secret agent and monitors local gambling.In the Philippines, Vietnam, Malaysia, Indonesia and China, he carefully observes people and their behavior.He discovers that all corners of the world are an inexhaustible source of knowledge.

programs.title: Woman at the end of the world
programs.desc: In southern China, at the foot of the Himalayas, Martyna Wojciechowska visits the Mosuo tribe.In their culture, there is no concept of father or husband, and the role of the head of the house is played by women who make all important decisions.They never marry, and their surnames are inherited by all family members.The traveler meets LaSuo, who lives with her daughter, mother, grandmother and uncle.The woman's father stays with her own mother, as do her daughters.Martyna will also learn the Mosuo dance, in which the first declarations are made between a man and a woman.

programs.title: Woman at the end of the world
programs.desc: In Bulgaria, Martyna visits a traditional family belonging to the small Kalajj ethnic group.Only 18,000 of them live in the country.The Kalajjs care very much about the purity of the group, and they arrange marriages only between their own kin.The young people get to know each other and observe each other for years, and if a bachelor catches the eye of a girl, negotiations begin.Every year, everyone comes to the area of ​​Stara Zagora on Saint Theodore's Day.Martyna meets 19-year-old Vasylka.The girl will present herself at this year's virgin market.The traveler accompanies her in preparations, during which they choose a dress and bake a traditional cake.He also learns about the amazing customs of the Kalajj people, their financial negotiations and the type of test that is supposed to prove that the bride has actually remained chaste until her wedding night.

programs.title: Woman at the end of the world
programs.desc: The World Health Organization estimates that there are approximately 170,000 people with vitiligo in Tanzania.Albinos are very susceptible to burns and skin cancer.Many of them die before the age of 40.The threat is not only from the harsh African sun, but also from other people.In Tanzania, it is common to believe that the body of an albino has magical powers.Hunting of them is becoming more and more common.Martyna visits a school where a hundred children suffering from vitiligo study.He also meets 19-year-old Kabula.A girl aged 12 was brutally attacked.After the incident, she is determined to become a lawyer and defend the rights of people affected by albinism in the future.Together with Martyna, they will visit her parents, whom she has not seen for 5 years.Previously, the girl did not have the courage to come home.
